tests.name: json_view_coordinate_float_16_digits
tests.intent: Probes fast coordinate float reading and dumping for 16-digit floating point numbers.

tests.name: json_view_coordinate_float_17_digits
tests.intent: Probes fast coordinate float reading and dumping for 17-digit floating point numbers.

tests.name: json_view_coordinate_float_pair_optimization
tests.intent: Probes the optimized array of two floats dump codepath for geographic coordinate pairs.

tests.name: json_view_decimal_layout_parsing
tests.intent: Probes the layout_decimal and layout_float path with fractional components.

tests.name: json_view_negative_coordinate_float
tests.intent: Probes negative floats with 16 digits for correct sign handling in coordinate decoding.

tests.name: json_view_float_batch_capacity
tests.intent: Probes float batch serialization storage capacities and header definitions.

tests.name: json_view_float_materialize_fallback
tests.intent: Probes standard float materialization paths when coordinate optimizations are bypassed.

tests.name: json_view_sixteen_digits_boundary
tests.intent: Probes sixteen_digits parsing logic with exactly 16 character boundaries.

tests.name: json_view_locate_token_bounds
tests.intent: Probes token location and rounding behavior for numbers near ties.

tests.name: json_view_multiple_floats_dump
tests.intent: Probes serialization performance and correctness with multiple sequential float entries.

tests.name: json_view_equality_operator_floats
tests.intent: Probes equality comparison involving view floats and standard basic_json instances.

tests.name: json_view_get_float_types
tests.intent: Probes template specializations of get() for float and double types on view nodes.

tests.name: json_view_nested_float_arrays
tests.intent: Probes nested arrays of floats to verify batch propagation during recursive dump walks.

tests.name: json_view_pretty_print_floats
tests.intent: Probes pretty printing formatting output with indent parameters on coordinate floats.

tests.name: json_view_empty_array_float_check
tests.intent: Probes edge cases where coordinate pair optimization encounters empty or short arrays.

tests.name: json_view_single_element_array_float
tests.intent: Probes single element array handling to ensure coordinate pair optimization skips correctly.

tests.name: json_view_three_element_array_float
tests.intent: Probes three element array handling to ensure coordinate pair optimization avoids mismatch.

tests.name: json_view_mixed_type_array_dump
tests.intent: Probes mixed type array serialization containing floats, strings, and integers.

tests.name: json_view_object_with_float_members
tests.intent: Probes object serialization containing long float keys and values.

tests.name: json_view_large_batch_stress
tests.intent: Probes large sequences of float elements to test batch capacity limits and heap allocation.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises convert_ahead, batch float serialization, and write_carried_digits by dumping an array of 16/17 digit floating-point numbers requiring carried rounding.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises locate_token, token_digits_2, and mask_if/select_if paths by formatting numbers that trigger g == 2 interval evaluations.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises write_double_beside and non-sequential node skips in float_batch when array nodes are selectively traversed or edited.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises trailing zero handling and write_token_digits optimization paths with numbers containing 12 or more trailing zero digits.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises coordinate_bits and coordinate_float fallback branches with boundary values such as zero or near-subnormal floats.
